title: 3.2 I, You, and We
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Connect speaker roles to I, you, and we and use I am, you are and we are with names and known actions.
grammar_function: I am; you are; we are. Speaker perspective is shown explicitly, not inferred from a third-person picture.
prerequisite: 3.1 greeting and name chunks and Unit 1 action sentences with is/are.
speaking_outcome: Say I am Ana., You are Luis. and I am/You are/We are with known actions.
